applies_to: train.py --loss contrastive (full CNN+BiMamba2 and CNN-only encoders)
output_layer: no classification head; the encoder emits a 512-d embedding for phages and hosts

loss.name: matrix-form squared-contrastive (matrix_contrastive_loss)
loss.distance: Euclidean distance between phage and host embeddings
loss.formula: mean over the batch of [ positive distance^2 + (1-positive) * max(0, margin-distance)^2 ] / 2
loss.host_embeddings: all candidate host embeddings are used in the matrix every batch

inference.rule: torch.cdist between each test phage embedding and all candidate host embeddings
inference.order: smaller distance is better; ranking by ascending distance
inference.softmax: none; probabilities are not produced at this stage
inference.temperature_scaling: applied separately as a post-hoc step on converted scores, not part of this head

bn_recalibration: 3 training-only passes, momentum=None, running stats re-estimated before final eval

architecture.conv1: Conv2d(1, 64, k=7, s=2) -> 64 x 29; BatchNorm; ReLU
architecture.conv2: Conv2d(64, 128, k=7, s=2) -> 128 x 12; BatchNorm; ReLU
architecture.mamba2: single bidirectional block; d_state=128, d_conv=4, d_inner=256, 4 heads, chunk=64

training.checkpoint: best validation top-1 within fixed epoch budget
